report.summary: Impact between car-0 and car-1 occurred at t = 4.626 s, with timing uncertainty about 0.042 s. From t = 3.426 to 4.426 s, car-0 was at 52.3 km/h (90% interval 49.3 to 56.1) and car-1 was at 30.5 km/h (90% interval 28.4 to 33.2). The speed element of the s1 statement was NOT consistent with the footage, and the light element cannot be checked from the footage, with 5 traffic lights in view. The s2 statements were consistent with the footage, including that no sustained braking was detected before impact.
limitations: Frame times come from the burned-in clock; frames the recorder dropped were placed using the vehicles' own motion.
